name: cursor-cost-preview
description: See a prompt's estimated cost before you send it in Cursor's Composer/Chat, with an optional hard block above a dollar threshold you set. 100% local, zero network calls.

BLOCK_THRESHOLD_USD.title: Block threshold (USD)
BLOCK_THRESHOLD_USD.description: Hard-block a prompt when its estimated cost exceeds this many dollars. Leave at 0 (default) to keep the gate informational-only — it will show an estimate but never block.
